title: Fox eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#ff7a1a'/>

  <ellipse cx='48' cy='74' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ffd9a8'/>

  <path d='M84 56 Q82 46 72 50 Q76 54 79 58 Q82 58 84 56 Z' fill='#fff4e0'/>

  <ellipse cx='18' cy='62' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#f2c46b'/>
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='60' rx='6' ry='3.4' fill='#ffe6a8'/>

  <circle cx='20' cy='62' r='0.8' fill='#d99a3c'/>
